events.label: Kick-off
events.purpose: Start the work and agree plant data access
events.decision: Which Braga plant data and which plant staff can the team access from week 1?
agenda: Present the two phases, workstreams and gate decisions
Review the data and people the baseline and line loss work need
Decide the plant data and staff access for the first weeks

events.label: Check-in: first findings
events.purpose: Review baseline and first loss findings
events.decision: Which loss types from the first findings go forward into improvement sizing?
agenda: Present the conversion cost per part baseline for Braga
Review the line loss findings from the first lines observed
Decide which loss types go into improvement sizing

events.label: Initiatives go/no-go
events.purpose: Decide which sized initiatives go ahead
events.decision: Which sized initiatives go into implementation at the plant, and which stop here?
agenda: Present the line loss analysis by production line and loss type
Review the sized improvement pack for the go/no-go decision
Decide which sized initiatives go into implementation

events.label: Workshop 1: readiness
events.purpose: Review readiness before anything goes live
events.decision: Which improvements are cleared to go live, and which need more readiness work?
agenda: Present the go-live readiness pack for each improvement
Review the cost-per-part tracker set against the baseline
Decide which improvements are cleared to go live

events.label: Workshop 2: early results
events.purpose: Review early results and plant ownership
events.decision: Which improvements need corrective action before the final readout?
agenda: Present the cost per part results after the first go-lives
Review the go-live records and the plant team ownership definition
Decide which improvements need corrective action

events.label: Final readout
events.decision: Approve the results against the baseline and the handover to the plant team?
agenda: Present the final readout pack: results against baseline and handover
Review the operation check, slippage log and plant team training record
Decide whether to approve the results and the plant team handover
